lede: Israel’s 2026 legislative election was the day’s dominant story across the web. It drew 925,801 Wikipedia views, more than twice the next most-read article, and Polymarket traders moved millions across linked markets, including $3.7 million in a single day on whether Benjamin Netanyahu becomes the next Prime Minister, a market now leaning slightly against him at about 45 percent. Away from the ballot, the Lakers led Google searches in both Britain and the United States, and Hacker News spent the day on its most-upvoted post, at 980 points, asking why a fingerprinting script was creating bioweapons.

throughlines.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
throughlines.gist: The vote was the single most-read article on Wikipedia yesterday and the subject of several of Polymarket’s busiest markets, the one story the rest of the feed kept circling back to.

throughlines.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
throughlines.gist: Traders put $3.7 million in a day on whether Netanyahu stays Prime Minister, a market leaning slightly against him at about 45 percent yes, while his Wikipedia biography sat among the day’s most-read.

throughlines.title: Dead by Daylight | Terrifier | Teaser
throughlines.gist: The horror game Dead by Daylight rode a Terrifier crossover teaser onto YouTube’s trending list while holding a place among Steam’s most-played titles, proof a well-timed trailer still moves both feeds at once.
